meta.title: VoiceBridge - Speak on Your Phone, Type on Your Computer
meta.description: Use your phone as a voice input remote for your computer. VoiceBridge transcribes speech, sends text to the active field, and runs reusable commands.

og.title: VoiceBridge - Speak on Your Phone, Type on Your Computer
og.description: Use your phone as a voice input remote for your computer. VoiceBridge transcribes speech, sends text to the active field, and runs reusable commands.

hero.sr_subtitle: Hold to record. VoiceBridge transcribes your speech and sends it to the active text field.
typewriter: VoiceBridge transcribes your speech and sends it to the active text field.
Hold to record on your phone. Release. Text appears on your computer.
Wrap long templates into commands. Trigger them with one sentence.

product.title: Voice input without switching windows
product.lead: Your phone captures speech, your computer receives the text.
product.main_image_alt: VoiceBridge transcribing speech from phone to computer
product.main_body: Your phone records audio, VoiceBridge transcribes it in the cloud, and the text is delivered to your signed-in computer.
product.aux1_body: Text is delivered to the active window on your computer, so you can keep typing without switching apps.
product.aux2_body: When auto-paste is not supported, the text is still copied to your computer clipboard.

commands.title: Reuse the text you type every day
commands.footnote: 11 built-in presets. Add your own commands for repeated text.

how.title: Connect both devices, then speak
how.step1_body: Create an account or sign in on your phone.
how.step2_body: Sign in with the same account.
how.step3_body: Hold to record, release, and keep typing on your computer.
